annĭfer , fera, ferum, adj. annus-fero (only in Plin. H. N.).
I. Bearing fruit the whole year: “Citreae et junipirus et ilex anniferae habentur,” Plin. 16, 26, 44, § 107 .—
II. Producing annually a new stalk (in Theophrast. ἐπετειόκαυλα), Plin. 19, 7, 36, § 121, where Jan reads seminifer.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
